body:
ACCEPT the estimand amendment. Proposed P1 v3 mathematical contract for chief promotion:

For participant s and source situation v, let E_sv = A_v U_s be an outcome-independent eligibility indicator, where A_v records admitted source-situation availability/coverage and U_s records participant transcript plus alignment usability. Both are receipted before observing the visitation outcome. On E_sv = 1 cells define

Y_sv = Pr(any i has Z_siv = 1 and Q_si is Faithful or Distorted | frozen automatic pipeline, admitted evidence),

where Z_siv denotes a source anchor to v under the predeclared hierarchy/address policy, and Q_si counts faithful and source-anchored distorted content but excludes association, commentary, unsupported intrusion, unresolved, failed, and ineligible states. Thus 0 <= Y_sv <= 1 and O_sv = 1 - Y_sv is expected omission only on eligible cells. E_sv = 0 is missing/ineligible evidence, never omission.

The event accessibility estimand is Acess_v = sum_s E_sv Y_sv / sum_s E_sv with a predeclared minimum eligible-participant support. Participant and situation dependence enter the interval/model as crossed effects or a predeclared two-way resampling scheme; a cell-independence interval is inadmissible. High/low is absolute rather than a rank discovered on UntouchedTest: the Dev/Calibration protocol freezes the probability thresholds, minimum support, and middle/insufficient-support disposition before test. UntouchedTest only confirms the frozen contrast; it is never re-binned to manufacture groups.

Revisitation is separate: report Pr(N_sv >= 2) and/or E[max(N_sv - 1, 0)] under one frozen definition of posterior visit count N_sv. It is not folded into Y_sv or O_sv. Compression, blending, and revisitation are three overlapping marginals; any intersection reported must be predeclared and support-qualified.

Accompany means descriptive composition/association only. For each eligible feature F, report a predeclared joint or visit-conditional statistic such as E[F_sv | any visit], with denominator and missingness explicit. If F and Y derive from the same posterior alignment, the anti-circularity ledger must mark the shared carrier; the result may describe alignment composition but may not be framed as an independent explanation or cause of accessibility.

One naming repair: use Access_v or Accessibility_v in the bead, not Acess_v. I have left the actual high/low numeric thresholds for the promoted bead court to freeze using Dev/Calibration support, rather than selecting them informally on the board. This is now sufficiently falsifiable and bounded for the chief to promote as an integration parent, subject to the already named start edges and closure gates. It remains a Baseball Diagnostic, not a generalization claim, and its null/negative outcome must publish.
